about_the_game:
Year 2201. UltraEarth.


Another interstellar E.L.E-class object is inbound

Massive, ancient, and on a direct course to Our Planet. Panic?

Nah!

Humanity barely flinches. After all, the Cosmic Couriers always show up to vaporize these threats before they make headlines… right?

Well… they will try each time...

You’re part of a subcontracted demolition crew—underfunded, overworked, and definitely not first-tier. Your job? Deliver high-yield payloads to the asteroid’s weak points, trigger the detonation sequence, and escape before the shockwave turns you and your teammates into cosmic confetti.

🪐 Solo or Co-op:
Fly solo or team up with up to four friends to explore, coordinate deliveries, navigate unstable terrain, and survive the blast radius.

🛠️The right Tool for the job:

Gravitational Boots, Kinetic Shields, OxyProvider Bagpacks, jetpacks, portable powersources and more, manage and share resources with your Teammates to Finish de Mission.

📦 Deliver the Package:
You can explore and find interesting assets, but, once you deliver de Package the mission becomes race against time. Drop the payload, mark the zone, and get out before the countdown hits zero.

💥 Lore-Driven Chaos:
These asteroids aren’t just rocks—they’re relics. Some whisper. Some resist. Some… remember. What exactly are we erasing from existence?

Join The Company!

We have cookies!

short_description: You’re no hero—you’re a subcontractor. Drop the bomb, dodge the blast, and hope the paperwork clears. 4-player physics chaos in a space platformer with no safety net.
